d: India’s bid to host the 2036 Olympics has sparked racist memes and AI-generated images, raising questions about outdated stereotypes, infrastructure and the country’s sporting ambitions. Meanwhile, controversy over India’s voter roll revision is intensifying, with opposition allegations of voter deletions prompting protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The Supreme Court has also questioned restrictions imposed in Delhi ahead of a planned demonstration, citing concerns for commuters. Hem Saroya examines both developments on Vantage on Firstpost.
